findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before authorizing document reads
findings.body: When a user and document belong to different tenants, `canReadDocument` now returns `true`, bypassing the function’s previous tenant-isolation contract. Any consumer relying on this exported authorization predicate can consequently permit cross-tenant document access.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant equality validation before authorizing document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now returns `true` for every request. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from a document’s `documentTenant` will be authorized if callers rely on this predicate, causing a cross-tenant data-access bypass.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation for document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request, so any user whose tenant differs from the document tenant can read cross-tenant documents when consumers rely on this exported authorization check.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
